name: True North x Wojo | 200mg Rosin Gummies | Strawberry Guava
description:
Two Award-Winning Michigan Brands. One Legendary Collab.
Wojo Co and True North Collective have teamed up to create solventless rosin-infused gummies that combine the best of both worlds — the purity and potency of Wojo’s solventless hash and the flavor and craftsmanship of True North’s premium confections. Loved by budtenders and connoisseurs alike, this collab blends artistry and clean medicine in one bite.
The Next Evolution In Solventless Edibles
Solventless. Full Spectrum. Award-Winning.
Infused with rosin pressed from Wojo’s in-house grown flower, these gummies deliver the full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes — without solvents, additives, or shortcuts.
Premium Gummy Recipe.
Each batch is made with True North’s signature vegan, gluten-free, and pectin-based recipe for a clean, consistent experience. Crafted in Michigan by the same kitchen team behind True North Confections’ most popular lines.
Wellness Meets Flavor.
Enjoy the entourage effect in every bite — solventless rosin provides the purest expression of the plant, balancing flavor, potency, and potential relief.
4-Piece 200mg Packs.
Each pack includes four 50mg pieces, perfect for experienced consumers looking for an authentic, full-bodied edible experience.
Flavor Collections.
Each gummy flavor mirrors one of Wojo’s exclusive solventless strains and is infused with rosin from that flavor collection.
Rosin is a form of concentrate that uses heat and pressure to extract cannabinoids, rather than solvents. Depending on the source material used for the extraction, rosin can vary widely in clarity and consistency.
